title: An Order and Pay read with no Authorization header is a 4xx; this unit answers 401 in the apePaymentBadRequestError shape

source.note: The page: 'If an access token becomes invalid or expired, a 4xx error will be returned'. The 401 status (RFC 6750 s3.1) and the body -- the Order and Pay tag's one named error component without timestamp and path -- are this unit's judgment.
